title: On a channel row, a system message the viewer caused does not count
why: Born-read on any row kind, as RisingWave counts it. Decided (Tenny, #14988 review): follow the server (RisingWave). The canonical Postgres inline read in getInboxItems (search, guest access, forced) still counts it.

knownGaps.reason: web's live patch (liveUnreadFields) applies the system rule on thread rows only, so it counts this on a channel or DM row
knownGaps.followUp: step 2 switches web to the shared predicate
